title: DescriptionGetReply
description: The parsed form of a description_get reply (the key of a plugin's description in the descriptions store, omx-panel docs/descriptions-store.md): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the plugin's binary, 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

format.description: The plugin's format: a plugin's, never a worker's row.

uri.description: The plugin's uri, as the add named it.

layer.description: The layer of the store that holds the entry: the user layer, the system layer or the base, the first that does in that order.
